objective: Implement local append-only episode decision log storage and retrieval exactly from the skill record contract, with meaningful negative/positive tests.
required_gate: none: authorized reusable skill tooling; does not execute canonical production
acceptance_checks: Append transaction rejects incomplete records, duplicate IDs, stale evidence and broken revision/feedback targets without modifying existing bytes
Hash chain detects tampering; status does not inherit old-version or reviewer acceptance
Query returns context/exception records from tags; no external or media actions
stopping_conditions: Finish helper/tests/report under owned path only
Do not write any actual episode log; root will seed it
